reason: The agent falsely claimed to the user that it has no way to check departure/arrival times or flight durations, failing to check `search_direct_flight` or `search_onestop_flight` (which include scheduled departure/arrival times). Additionally, the agent misstated policy regarding cabin upgrades ('Basic economy reservations cannot be modified — only cancelled'), whereas the policy explicitly states 'all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights'.
